title: Atlas launch planning
input_text:
Atlas launch planning meeting, 3 November 2026. Attendees: Priya Shah (PM), Marco Rossi (backend), Lena Park (frontend), Omar from Northwind Bank.

Priya: The public launch of Atlas is set for December 15, 2026. QA testing runs from December 8.
Marco: The new payments API in FastAPI should be ready by November 28, but that is tentative because we are still waiting on credentials from Northwind Bank.
Lena: Frontend integration depends on the payments API being available. Once the API is ready, I will connect the React checkout screens.
Marco and Lena will jointly write the end-to-end tests by December 5.
Priya: Deployment to AWS can only happen after QA testing passes.
Omar suggested moving the database to Oracle, but the team rejected it and will stay on PostgreSQL.
We originally agreed to launch in English only. Priya changed this: the launch will now include Spanish as well.
The marketing budget is $40,000, although finance has not approved it yet.
Someone needs to update the privacy policy before launch. It is urgent.
Later in the meeting Marco said the launch date is December 20, 2026, so the launch date needs confirming.
Open question: who will sign off the security review?

result.summary: The Atlas team set a public launch for December 15, 2026 with QA testing starting December 8, while the payments API is tentatively due November 28. Frontend integration and end‑to‑end tests are scheduled, and the launch language was expanded to include Spanish. The marketing budget of $40,000 awaits finance approval, and the exact launch date remains uncertain after a later suggestion of December 20. Outstanding items include updating the privacy policy and confirming who will sign off the security review.
